steps.name: Akafuyu
steps.text: Utage?

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Akafuyu?

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: I was gonna meet up with Kirara here. You seen her?

steps.name: Akafuyu
steps.text: What? The girl coming for treatment? You arranged to meet here too?!

steps.name: Unfamiliar Man
steps.text: Hey, uh, guide?

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: (Raises head for a glance)

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: (Lifts phone, points it at the highway scenery)

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: (Continues tapping on phone)

steps.name: Unfamiliar Man
steps.text: Ms. Guide—

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: (Taps on phone screen)

steps.name: Unfamiliar Man
steps.text: Whaddaya showing me your phone for...

steps.name: Unfamiliar Man
steps.text: 'guide...'

steps.name: Unfamiliar Man
steps.text: And then a question mark?

steps.name: Unfamiliar Man
steps.text: You're not the guide who's supposed to show me outta the city?!

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: (Taps on phone screen)

steps.name: Unfamiliar Man
steps.text: Then why'd you get in my car? The hell, did the L.G.D. send you?!

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: (Taps on phone screen)

steps.name: Unfamiliar Man
steps.text: Quit typing and talk to me!

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: I thought...

steps.name: Unfamiliar Man
steps.text: Clearly now!

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: I thought you were... the driver taking me to Rhodes Island...

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: 'Scuse me, you see a girl dragging this giant case around here?

steps.name: Male Passerby
steps.text: A girl with a giant case? Can't say I have.

steps.name: Female Passerby
steps.text: You're an hour late, you only just got here! Of course you haven't seen anything!

steps.name: Female Passerby
steps.text: Miss, are you talking about a teenaged girl towing a big suitcase, about as tall as you?

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Yeah, her! Was she, like, super-absorbed in a hand thingy playing a video game when you saw her?

steps.name: Female Passerby
steps.text: Can't say as such.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Come again?

steps.name: Female Passerby
steps.text: She was playing on something that seemed like a game console for a little bit, but then she put it away really fast, and pulled out her phone right after, and she'd just type and then send photos.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Phone?

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: (Her phone's gonna be from Higashi. Can she use it in Lungmen?)

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: (Nah, no time to sweat that.)

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Should be her, for sure. Do you know where she went?

steps.name: Female Passerby
steps.text: A car just stopped in front of her a moment ago, and then the driver and her had this look between them, and she took her suitcase and got in. The driver even moved it into the boot for her.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Where's the car headed?

steps.name: Unfamiliar Man
steps.text: Unbelievable...

steps.name: Unfamiliar Man
steps.text: My goddamn luck. The guide I book just so happens to be a young Ægir woman in a Higashinese outfit... How the hell does a stumbling block like you come outta the woodwork?!

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: Um...

steps.name: Unfamiliar Man
steps.text: If you got something to say, then say it!

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: I just wanted to ask... why... you thought I was wearing Higashinese clothing?

steps.name: Unfamiliar Man
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Unfamiliar Man
steps.text: You're garbed up like you walked right outta one of them Higashinese mangos. If that's not the look, what is?

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: I think you only really look stereotypically Higashinese if you dress like a samurai or a miko or...

steps.name: Unfamiliar Man
steps.text: Samurai? Miko? Isn't that all just manga stuff? They really got types like that walking around over there?

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: Uh... never mind.

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: What are you... driving this... fast for?

steps.name: Unfamiliar Man
steps.text: Huh? I'm trying to get home!

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: See, but was gonna meet up with a friend and she was waiting literally where I got in this car... and could you just take me back before you go home?

steps.name: Unfamiliar Man
steps.text: Fuhgeddaboutit!

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: Orrr... where do you live? You could go home first and then I'll find a way to get my friend to pick me up...

steps.name: Unfamiliar Man
steps.text: My home's in Siracusa. That good enough for you?

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: S-S-Siracusa?!

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: That's NG, that's totally not happening! I came here all the way from Higashi, I don't have time for a trip to Siracusa too!

steps.name: Unfamiliar Man
steps.text: Grgh.

steps.name: Unfamiliar Man
steps.text: See this knife here, ragazza?

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: Don't tell me you're with... the mafia? The Siracusan mafia?!

spans.text: Don't tell me you're with... the mafia? The

steps.name: Unfamiliar Man
steps.text: Not exactly... but yeah, something like that.

steps.name: Unfamiliar Man
steps.text: You sit tight and make peace with it. You're my hostage now.

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: But... you said you missed your guide, so even if you leave Lungmen you still...

steps.name: Unfamiliar Man
steps.text: Shut it! I ain't giving you no second chance!

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: That stupid pickpocket didn't just rob a jewelers, he went and nabbed a hostage...

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: Truly sorry, Miss Akafuyu, that we requested cooperation with Rhodes Island on this investigation and still let this mess happen, and we got your friend involved in it.

steps.name: Akafuyu
steps.text: Save those words for later! What step are you at in your measures?

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: We've already sent officers to every expressway and city exit so we can conduct vehicle-to-vehicle inspections...

steps.name: Unfamiliar Man
steps.text: Clammin' up again? What gives?

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: (Lifts up handheld device)

steps.name: Unfamiliar Man
steps.text: You're in the world's nuttiest situation and you still got time to play video games?

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: (Nods)

steps.name: Unfamiliar Man
steps.text: You don't got a lick of sense.

steps.name: Unfamiliar Man
steps.text: What, sick of games now? On your phone again?

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: ...I brought this phone from Higashi.

steps.name: Unfamiliar Man
steps.text: So?

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: I can't use a Higashinese phone in Lungmen.

steps.name: Unfamiliar Man
steps.text: Huh.

steps.name: Unfamiliar Man
steps.text: Lemme see what you're typing there.

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: No!

steps.name: Unfamiliar Man
steps.text: Clam it and give me the phone!

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: No way! Never ever!

steps.name: Unfamiliar Man
steps.text: You give me that—

steps.name: Unfamiliar Man
steps.text: Cazzo, a traffic jam?

steps.name: Unfamiliar Man
steps.text: Great, perfect. I got my hands free now, ragazza. You give the phone and let me see. If you're not blabbin' to nobody about nothing, we won't have a problem.

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: I promise you, I'm not doing anything that would be unbeneficial to you!

steps.name: Unfamiliar Man
steps.text: The hell's a promise do? If promises meant shit, would I have gotten duped all the way out to here?

steps.name: Unfamiliar Man
steps.text: Just give me the damn phone!

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: I'm gonna lock it first, okay?

steps.name: Unfamiliar Man
steps.text: No, you're not—

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: I think whoever's in the car over has been staring at us!

steps.name: Unfamiliar Man
steps.text: What?!

steps.name: Unfamiliar Man
steps.text: Merda!

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: I'm not typing anymore, I'm putting the phone away, I'm gonna keep playing games, okay?

steps.name: Unfamiliar Man
steps.text: Okay, you've been going 'ah' every coupla minutes and nothing else. What the hell is it?

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: I, uh... I've died four or five times on this stage. I... I think I'm tilted.

steps.name: Unfamiliar Man
steps.text: Am I messing you up here?

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: No...

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: (Instinctively pulls out phone)

steps.name: Unfamiliar Man
steps.text: The hell you think you're up to?!

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: Sorry—sorry! I just did it automatically!

steps.name: Unfamiliar Man
steps.text: Huh.

steps.name: Unfamiliar Man
steps.text: Once I'm back in Siracusa, I'll let you go, and you can text your texts, game your games, nobody'll bother you.

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: You're seriously going back to Siracusa?

steps.name: Unfamiliar Man
steps.text: The hell else am I gonna go? Cousin sent me packing to Lungmen like a dumbass, said business here was honey and wine... Whose honey? Ain't no business worth nothing!

steps.name: Unfamiliar Man
steps.text: I'm telling you, they baited him in, he joined up with a famiglia, and figured he'd get his own little errand boy!

steps.name: Unfamiliar Man
steps.text: I spent months holding my breath, following him and his business around until I was drowning in all their petty shit. Said I wanted to go home once! Just once! And he robs a jewelry store, pins all the charges on me!

steps.name: Unfamiliar Man
steps.text: I ain't about to throw away decades a million miles from home!

steps.name: Unfamiliar Man
steps.text: I got my mamma and papà in Siracusa! They were begging me like crazy before I left, but I was stupider than bricks, and not one word, I didn't listen to one word they said...

steps.name: Unfamiliar Man
steps.text: I just wanna go home, wanna see them! One more time! And if the powers that be say I'm a coward and decide to sink me into a river, then that's the price I gotta pay!

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: (Habitually pulls out phone and begins typing)

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: (Quietly) Honestly... I don't wanna be away from home either.

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: (Quietly) I went through a lot of my own pain getting out here, all the way from home...

steps.name: Unfamiliar Man
steps.text: Come again?

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: Nothing.

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: You don't have a guide, though, even... Are you really gonna make it back to Siracusa?

steps.name: Unfamiliar Man
steps.text: Whaddaya want me to do? Ask the L.G.D.?

steps.name: Unfamiliar Man
steps.text: Sure, I got duped, but I'm still a mafioso. What, a suit walking right up to the fuzz? Saying 'I got set up?' You think they'll listen?

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: If they don't wanna listen to you, then it doesn't matter how much you tell them, they're just gonna go by their preconceptions so they can misinterpret whatever you say. I know that.

steps.name: Unfamiliar Man
steps.text: Okay, see, I thought you were just gonna risk your life begging me to 'explain the situation' to an L.G.D.

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: But, uh, even if you can't convince them, you're probably not gonna die... On the other hand, if you run into trouble in the wasteland then you're definitely never making it back.

steps.name: Unfamiliar Man
steps.text: Hold on.

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Unfamiliar Man
steps.text: Hold on, that—is that an L.G.D. roadblock?! Are they checking cars?!

steps.name: Unfamiliar Man
steps.text: Hey, and I see you pulled out your phone again, huh?!

steps.name: Unfamiliar Man
steps.text: You were sending the L.G.D. a nice little tip-off after all! Gimme that damned thing—

steps.name: Akafuyu
steps.text: Cease!

steps.name: Akafuyu
steps.text: Kirara, get out of the car now! We're Rhodes Island operators, we're here for you!

steps.name: Unfamiliar Man
steps.text: God damned L.G.D. laphounds!

steps.name: Akafuyu
steps.text: Kirara, grab my hand—

steps.name: Akafuyu
steps.text: What is it? Why are you frozen? This is an urgent situation; whatever it is, you can save it for later!

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: But—

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Relax, Kirara, I got your collection out the trunk already. You get out of the car with Akafuyu. L.G.D.'ll take care of the perp!

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: Utage?!

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: A—Alright!

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: (Sighs)

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Okay, guy kinda gave us the runaround, but you're alright, the luggage you were protecting the whole way's fine, it's all good. Medetashi, medetashi.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Kirara, hello?

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: I know you're in shock, but, like, you're gonna block traffic if you keep standing there, okay?

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: Oh! Sorry...

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: You got your fruit tea, you've tried Lungmen's famous finballs. I bet you feel calmer now, right, girl?

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: Um... mmhm. Thanks, Utage.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Lemme get you introduced. This real samurai-vibey lady's Rhodes Island Operator Akafuyu. Should've been her sitting in the car, actually, with the robber guy.

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: Why?

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: She's the whole 'guide' he was talking about.

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: The... young Higashinese-dressed Ægir woman... he was looking for... was her?

steps.name: Akafuyu
steps.text: Indeed. The L.G.D. has been following him, but scared of alarming him, they had me act the guide, so he could be seized at an opportune moment.

steps.name: Akafuyu
steps.text: Who knew I'd be so careless, and even draw you in, Kirara. I am truly sorry to startle you.

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: It's... alr...

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: (Habitually fishes out phone)

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: (Alarmedly rummages for phone)

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: It's not polite to send your thanks via text if they're right in front of you, girl.

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: N—No... I left my phone in that car!

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Chill, we'll pick out a new one for you in a bit. Call it a little get-well-soon.

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: But I've got a lot of important stuff on that phone, and I mean really, honestly important stuff!

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: You got, like, game cheat codes on there? Or some kinda training notes so you can beat the super tough guys?

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: Okay... yes, both of those are in there but I don't mean them!

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: Utage, can we follow that car?

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Akafuyu?

steps.name: Akafuyu
steps.text: This pursuit is in the L.G.D.'s hands now. If we give further chase, I fear we'll simply make trouble for them.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: She looks anxious for real to me.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: I know her, and I don't think losing her entire collection forever in that car would, like, get to her as bad as this.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Right, Kirara?

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: (Fiercely nods)

steps.name: Akafuyu
steps.text: If so, it's not as if we can't send word to the L.G.D. Where should we look for him, however, given he raced away from the checkpoint?

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: That's—no worries, I can handle that...

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: You go, Kirara. What, you can pin your phone's location on your handheld or?

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: Actually, I modded all my electronics before I left so I could protect against losing anything, so they've all got relative tracking functions to each other...

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Whoa, you got even crazier at modding tech stuff and I never knew!

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: Anyhow, that red point that's been moving the whole time is my phone's position, so it looks like that guy hasn't realized I left it in his car yet...

steps.name: Akafuyu
steps.text: Given so, we have an easy in.

steps.name: Akafuyu
steps.text: Utage, your classmate here is by no means of ordinary ability.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Preach it. All of my friends are showstoppers. I know that best.

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: Haha...

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: Straight for five hundred meters and then take the next right.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: The way you've been, like, looking at the map on your console and then giving directions, it's kinda like you're playing a game.

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: No, that's not really what's going on, I'm just... just looking at a map.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: This is no time for modesty, girl.

steps.name: Voices From Far Away
steps.text: ...resisting...

steps.name: Voices From Far Away
steps.text: ...give yourself up...

steps.name: Akafuyu
steps.text: No mistake. We've made dead heat on the target!

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: Stop resisting! Lay your weapons down, put your hands up and come out!

steps.name: Unfamiliar Man
steps.text: I don't want none—none of you near me!

steps.name: Unfamiliar Man
steps.text: Let me go, I wanna leave Lungmen, I'm going back to Siracusa, I wanna go home!

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: Let it go! Now lay your weapons down, and we can still approach you with an open mind!

steps.name: Unfamiliar Man
steps.text: Like hell! I know what you're gonna do to me—I ain't no fool! I'm going home, dammit, I just need to get out of here and back to Siracusa!

steps.name: Unfamiliar Man
steps.text: First that stupid cousin, then the 'famiglia,' and now you, and that girl just earlier, you're all out for blood! You're all filthy liars!

steps.name: Unfamiliar Man
steps.text: I want you all gone! Get out of my goddamn way! You're not fooling me no more! I'm going home!

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Shoot, I think he snapped.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: This is kind of a stalemate, so the L.G.D. are gonna go to force soon. I don't think we can guarantee your phone'll survive a firefight, and that guy is, like, the world vs. him at this point.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Akafuyu, you think we can slip in?

steps.name: Akafuyu
steps.text: Absolutely not. The L.G.D. cannot ensure our safety should we intrude over the cordon. We can only pray the man calms down soon.

steps.name: Akafuyu
steps.text: I did ask the L.G.D. His jewelry store robbery had no casualties, which should mean they take him into custody.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Ugh, yeah, custody beats dying any day. So when's he gonna realize it, again?

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: But he... said he was framed.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Huh?!

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: While we were in the car he told me, he didn't actually rob that store, he was set up by somebody else.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Did he actually, factually say that?

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: Yeah...

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Akafuyu, could you tell that to an L.G.D. guy for us, please?

steps.name: Akafuyu
steps.text: I could, no issue, but the L.G.D. wouldn't let him walk on a single person's testimony.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Still better than watching everyone fry right now! Go!

steps.name: Akafuyu
steps.text: Understood!

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Maybe they'll change up their gameplan once they find out. Fingers crossed.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Let's get outta here for now, Kirara. I mean, you can tell, but we're just counting on other people at this point.

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: Final warning! Drop your weapons!

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: If you still refuse to comply with the law, we will authorize the use of force!

steps.name: Unfamiliar Man
steps.text: Damn you all to hell! I get it, you just wanted me here all along so you could take my life!

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: I'll count to ten! If you won't give yourself up before then, we WILL use force!

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: One...

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Shoot, I don't think she's gonna make it. Hey, Kirara, you might wanna prep mentally to...

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Kirara? What are you doing?
Kirara has her handheld up, and her finger is dancing all across the screen.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: That's... not the console's interface, that's, like, beyond it. You made that? You're sending instructions from your own interface?

spans.text: That's... not the console's interface, that's, like, beyond it. You made that? You're sending instructions from your

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: Two...

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: Three...

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: Four...

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Are you trying to dial yourself from your console? You wanna get talking with him?

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: It's just... a wake-up call.

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: Please, please...

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: Nine...

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: Ten!

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: We are authorizing the use of force, all positions—

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: Target sighted, no weapons on person!

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: Target is stripped of all arms...

steps.name: HR Operator
steps.text: Your hospitalization procedures are all in order, Miss Kirara.

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: (Taps on phone screen)

steps.name: HR Operator
steps.text: 'thanks'?

steps.name: HR Operator
steps.text: No problem!

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Kirara, come on, didn't I tell you? It's so rude to type when you're literally, like, face to face!

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: So... rry.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Eh, no big. I know it was more than a day or two that got you like this.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: C'mon, lemme show you where you're living!

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Seriously, that night? Everything hanging in the balance? I thought he was gonna die.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Honestly, after all that and the shock you went through, you're incredible. I can't believe you testified for him anyway.

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: So, did they pass his verdict yet?

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Doesn't happen that fast, girl.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: But I heard Akafuyu say the L.G.D. finished their investigation and figured out it wasn't actually him who held up the jewelry store. Now he's got charges for obstructing public duty and... something, whatever it was? I don't remember.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Considering he also kinda got baited into the mafia too, he'll probably get a year and a half and then deported out.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Which, like, it only panned out this way thanks to you.

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: All I did was make him notice my phone, and that was it.

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: He saw what was on there and realized I wasn't lying to him while I was in the car. Wasn't more than that.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Seriously? Sooo what kinda spell did you put in your phone to make a hard-boiled guy like that give himself up?

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: It wasn't a spell or anything, just some super normal stuff.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: You sure?

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: Of course I'm sure!

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: So normal, you won't even let me see?

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: You seriously don't need to, I'm not kidding!

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Hmm...

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Not gonna push you, then.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Bye-bye, Kirara. Get some sleep if you're worn out, okay?

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: It's not a spell or incantation or anything, it's just...

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: Just some stuff I need to copy and mail out.
Kirara fishes out her phone, and scrolls the whole way down her drafts, until she hits the day she set out.
Since leaving that nomadic city she called home, her phone's mail service has been out of commission.
But leaving home for the first time, the girl still records everything she sees, hears, feels and thinks, no matter how big or small, in her drafts folder.
Kirara pulls a sheet of letter paper from her drawer, and copies from her drafts, going character by character, by word, by sentence.
A folder filled both with great chunks of text, and messy fragments of phrases.

a.text: 'day 2. completely out of nomadic city signal range today, no more using phone to stay in touch anymore. dont worry though, once im at rhodes island like utage says, ill send you all a million letters.'
'day 5. sat in a car the whole day. insanely bumpy over the wasteland, couldnt even play my handheld the whole way or else id throw up.'

'day 11. in yan now, road suddenly got way better! plants look kind of like home here but also kind of not, could only vaguely tell, i dont know plants much anyway. driver switched to someone yanese too, looks really tough but actually kind of chill, gave me some snacks apparently specialty of yan. wonder if theres a lot of yanese people at rhodes island?'

steps.text: Kirara devotedly copies, filling page after letter page, until she reaches the draft dated latest.

a.text: 'day 34. finally in lungmen! agreed to meet utage in the city tonight, but she said something came up and she couldnt make it and someone else would meet up with me. she likes joking a lot though so maybe shell actually show up.

'waited on an empty stomach the whole day until the guy whos meeting me finally showed up. seems kind of unapproachable. hope its not all guys like him at rhodes island or else im never gonna be able to say a word.
'i think i got in the wrong car. drivers not rhodes island, hes siracusan mafia. he says hes going to go back to siracusa what do i do
'he got framed from the start, he just wants to go home.

'ive been missing home the whole time actually, i just held it in and never wrote about it before. everythings really nice in yan, but the food keeps being different everywhere and i cant get used to it, i always get stomach aches, i cant use my phone i cant send mail i cant chat with my friends i dont even have the guts to talk to anyone its horrible, the wind is really harsh in the wastes and sand got in my eyes nobody even helped me i just had to get it out with a napkin myself

'if i make it out of here alive and if my oripathy gets stable when rhodes island is in higashi i promise ill come back to see you i promise ill be a cheerful happy person i wont worry you anymore i promise'

steps.text: The draft abruptly ends there.
Kirara tears up the sheet that contains this draft, crumples it into a ball, and throws it on the floor.
She locks her phone screen, and on a fresh sheet of paper writes anew, 'day 34'.

a.text: 'day 34. finally in lungmen! me and utage met up in the city, utage took me to rhodes island. no twists along the way at all, it all went smooth.
